title: Relationship Courtesy Days on Kestrel Advantage Balloon Payoff Quotes
content:
**Relationship courtesy.** A customer quoted a payoff on a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract who keeps other Kestrel accounts current has quote interest days after the maturity date not charged. The lines counted are the **Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract**, the **Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract** and the **Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease**; a line counts when the customer holds an active account in it showing 0 days past due.

| Lines with an active account at 0 days past due | Quote interest days after maturity not charged |
|---|---|
| Two or three | 4 |
| Exactly one | 2 |
| None | None |

The records read are the status and days past due of the customer's new-vehicle retail contracts, pre-owned retail contracts and leases.

## Hypothetical cases

- An active lease at 0 days past due and an active pre-owned retail contract at 0 days past due: 4 days.
- An active new-vehicle retail contract at 0 days past due and an active lease at 8 days past due: 2 days.
- A paid-in-full new-vehicle retail contract only: none.
